configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.description: The fastest build for the machine that compiles it: Release, tuned with -march=native, products and sums fused where the machine can. The one to use when building from the sources.

configurePresets.name: reproducible
configurePresets.description: Native, but without fusing products and sums: a few per cent slower, and its results are exactly those of the published packages.

configurePresets.name: portable
configurePresets.description: The build of the published packages: Release for the baseline of the processor family, so the binary runs on any machine of it.
